claims.claim: Comment accessible name and expanded-content association
claims.evidence: Keyboard activation, aria-expanded and live aria-controls target (a11y interactions).
24 settled route/theme/viewport axe scans; muted token ratios 4.97–7.36:1. SVG incomplete nodes remain unverified.

claims.claim: Mobile navigation modality, containment, inertness, Escape, scroll lock, focus restoration
claims.evidence: Native :modal, forward/reverse Tab, rejected background focus, AX-tree isolation, Escape restoration.
320px native modal; containment, inertness, Escape/restoration and scroll lock.
Native dialog :modal=false, background focus and scrolling remain available; Escape from background closes.
First Tab exposes skip link; Enter focuses main#dashboard-content.
One main, without header/nav/aside descendants on all six settled routes.
Correct principal-route links expose aria-current=page, including mobile.
Named groups with one pressed selection; keyboard Space changes all three.
Both tooltip geometries remain within320px viewport with8px edge margins.
Individual behaviors pass, but pointer leave hides a still-focused trigger tooltip: A11Y-1.
Additive optional props, five typechecks/four builds and Website/SSO/Mobile smoke. Behavioral defects separately reported.
Deferred chart chunk (~90,170B) loads on Overview/Evolution after page content; absent on Settings. Failure recovery is separateBP-01.
Identical 332×250px chart geometry before/after load at390px; CLS0 in all measured sessions. Skeleton overflow is separate A11Y-2.
Orbz definition followsFCP inall9throttledsessions; dimensions/reduced-motion source preserved.
Voice dialog opens with decorative Orbz import blocked and custom element undefined. This verifies independence, not interactivity before React hydration.
Overview→Evolution→Settings→Evolution retains in-document sentinel; internal Next links.
Theme/product/range/classification/group persist. Selected point statically inspected, not separately asserted.

claims.evidence: Account, product, notifications and mobile-navigation runtime transitions.
Replacement and close browser races; unmount unit checks; locale cleanup statically inspected.

No x-powered-by response header; poweredByHeader:false.

findings.title: Tooltip disappears while keyboard focus remains
findings.evidence: Focus Account, hover it, move pointer away; after120ms tooltip disappears but trigger staysfocused. PreviousHEAD focus-within behavior didnot disappear. WCAG1.4.13 persistence.

findings.title: Chart retry cannot recover a transient deferred-chunk failure
findings.evidence: Abort deferredchart chunk, allow network again, press Tryagain; route refreshes but alert remains andchartcount0. Documentreload recovers. Module-level Reactlazy rejectioncached; Nextretryprop correct.

findings.title: Loading skeleton overflows320px viewport by12px
findings.evidence: During skeleton document.scrollWidth332 atviewport320; settledwidth320. Decorativew-80 track causesoverflow. Not provenWCAGcontent/functionloss.

findings.title: Visible PT-BR label differs from accessible name
findings.evidence: Experimental LH label-content-name-mismatch score0, categoryweight0. PT-BR vs Português(Brasil). Abbreviationcase needsmanualspeech/conformance review, notconfirmedWCAGfailure.

findings.title: Dark voice submit button has insufficient contrast
findings.status: Confirmed newly discovered pre-existing issue (source attribution)
findings.evidence: Enabled normal16px/400 Ask button: #f5f5f5 on #f97316, contrast2.5711:1 versus required4.5:1. Confirmed after750ms theme plus750ms overlay settling, opacity1 throughout ancestors. Same classes/tokens inHEAD; baseline production runtime not rebuilt.
